scientific_review.assessment: JAK2 and STAT4 joint-intervention findings recovered and Runx3 retained without glucose-expression causal inflation. Four DM-rat/HG-HUVEC expression observations are lost. Grounding is achieved partly by omission, not by faithful dual-setting representation.
correctly_enriched: Runx3 [18] effects now explicitly include abrogation of the Cb1 endothelial-function effect
scientific_review.evidence_review_basis: All 23 assertions and populated rich fields are directly supported by their saved evidence. Joint JAK2/STAT4 wording is retained in both [16,17] assertions. Glucose [9] is tied only to the explicitly stated in-vitro model induction. No contextual glucose entity is promoted to a gene-expression actor.
flags: JAK2/STAT4 intervention field is generic Overexpression; assertions preserve the joint manipulation and must govern interpretation
[7] predicate alleviates is less qualified than control appears_to_alleviate; assertion still preserves appears
Title and conclusion pathways remain separately represented as in control; no duplicate explosion
lost_outcomes: Control [11-14] reduced Cbl and elevated JAK2, Runx3, STAT4 observations omitted
Control [6] DM characterized by impaired endothelial function omitted
Runx3 HUVEC context field disappears, though HUVECs remain explicit in assertion/effects/evidence
